dogecoin.text: XRP continues to gain steam in South Korea, leaving Bitcoin and Dogecoin behind. XRP’s performance didn’t start in the new year, but it continued last year’s momentum, with its trading volume in South Korea surpassing Bitcoin and Ethereum in 2018.
